`corePlugins` is not supported in Tailwind v4.
In Tailwind v4, configuration is CSS-first using the `<REDACTED_USER>` directive — no separate `tailwind.config.js` file is needed.
<code-snippet name="Extending Theme in CSS" lang="css">
--color-brand: oklch(0.72 0.11 178);
In Tailwind v4, you import Tailwind using a regular CSS `<REDACTED_USER>` statement, not using the `<REDACTED_USER>` directives used in v3:
<code-snippet name="Tailwind v4 Import Tailwind Diff" lang="diff">
<REDACTED_USER> base;
<REDACTED_USER> components;
<REDACTED_USER> utilities;
+ <REDACTED_USER> "tailwindcss";
Tailwind v4 removed deprecated utilities. Do not use the deprecated option - use the replacement.
Opacity values are still numeric.
| bg-opacity-* | bg-black/* |
| text-opacity-* | text-black/* |
| border-opacity-* | border-black/* |
| divide-opacity-* | divide-black/* |
| ring-opacity-* | ring-black/* |
| placeholder-opacity-* | placeholder-black/* |
| flex-shrink-* | shrink-* |
| flex-grow-* | grow-* |
| overflow-ellipsis | text-ellipsis |
| decoration-slice | box-decoration-slice |
| decoration-clone | box-decoration-clone |
</laravel-boost-guideline
